newsitem.title: USA: Tab Products names Kantz president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Tab Products names Kantz president, CEO.

text.p: TAB Products Co said it named Philip Kantz chief executive officer and president.

It said Kantz has almost 30 years in technology, transportation and financial services businesses, and has served as chief executive officer and President of Transcisco Industries Inc, Genetrix Inc, and Itel Containers International Corp.
Currently he is a director of 3Com Corporation and of Parc Place-Digitalk, Inc.
Kantz replaces John W. Peth, who has served as TAB's Acting CEO since 1996 and prior to that was its Chief Operating Officer.
